leo-marketing: quick ask for the launch one-pager: can runtime run a compact reproducible sweep for embed+rerank so we can lock the headline numbers?

leo-marketing: Requirements: cohort=150, mix=70% short (<120t)/30% long (1k-3k), compare rwin-open-7b fp32 vs rwin-open-7b-int8, output p50/p90/p99/p999 + token throughput. Include one slide-ready rerank example (scrubbed).

ali-runtime: got it. timeline? we can do a smoke run tonight and full sweep tomorrow afternoon. smoke will include the mini report + one annotated rerank pair per variant.

anya-eng: pls tag traces with campaign=launch-onepager, deck=hero, and include span annotation warmup=true/false. README should list runtime git sha, model sha, and instance SKU.

sam-devex: also add metric ids for latency and ndcg in the README for quick dashboard wiring.

leo-marketing: priority high for copy freeze. if full sweep slips send smoke artifacts so design can finish.

bench-bot: Job queued  id=70123 queue=staging-bench variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8] cohort=150 longpct=30 ETA smoke=2024-08-02T03:00Z.

ali-runtime: repro command we'll run: run_bench --cohort=onepager_pack.json --models=rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8 --warmup=25 --samples=150 --trace-tags "campaign=launch-onepager,deck=hero" --output artifacts/2367890123-onepager.tar.gz

ali-runtime: we'll capture per-request latencies, kernel timings, device metrics, and include 8 tail examples per variant. PII will be scrubbed; slide examples kept human-readable.

bench-bot: Job 70123 started on staging-node-05 at 2024-08-02T02:58:12Z.

leo-marketing: thanks team 44d please ping here with the smoke artifact link so we can finalize copy.
